title: Survival X: Resourcpack
description: That pack is the 2nd edition of the Realpack.It adds coll features for my Curseforge modpacks (Profile is ChrisZoneDEOfficial)
body:
**_INFORMATION: This pack is the 2nd version of the old archivet Realpack (link below). _**

https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/realpack2
That pack looks similar to the Realpack, because the beta-1 is the Beta-7 in the Realpack.
This is the pack for the Survival Modpacks by me on Curseforge (Profile: ChrisZoneDEOfficial)
Experience Minecraft in a whole new way with this realistic resource pack for version 1.20.4. Designed to enhance immersion, this pack transforms the game’s visuals with high-quality textures, detailed blocks, and refined lighting effects while staying true to the original Minecraft style.

From more natural terrain and realistic wood grains to improved stone, metal, and environment textures, every element has been carefully reworked to create a more lifelike world. Subtle details like smoother gradients, enhanced shadows, and more believable materials make your builds stand out like never before.

This resource pack is perfect for players who want a survival or fighting look without completely losing the classic Minecraft feel. It works great for survival and cinematic projects.

Features:


Improved block and item details

Optimized for Minecraft 1.20.4
Balanced fight-design while keeping the vanilla vibe


If you find bugs, report the here: https://discord.gg/7RxqnYuCb (The same as Realpack)

(no) Credits: The Glowing Ore texture looks like https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/animated-ore-with-frames , but it's my own. It's funny to see that my textures looks 1:1 with this texture :)
